instructions.primary_message: FOR THE VEGAN "MEATBALLS": Preheat oven to 375°F. Coat a large baking dish with oil and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ lb cremini mushrooms

instructions.primary_message: Trim, peel, and coarsely grate carrots. Place in a large bowl.
Peel, halve, and mince onion. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the carrot.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add carrot, onion, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 5-6 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half of the parsley to the reserved bowl. (Set remaining parsley aside for serving.)
When the vegetables are done, add to the bowl with the parsley along with the veggie ground. Using a spoon or your hands, mix well to combine. (Reserve pot for later use.)
Using a scant ¼-cup measure, form the veggie ground mixture into “meatballs.” Arrange in the baking dish.
Place baking dish in the oven and bake until meatballs are cooked through, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
FOR THE MUSHROOM GRAVY: While the meatballs are cooking, thinly slice mushrooms and place in a clean medium bowl.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice additional onion lengthwise. Peel and mince additional garlic. Add both to the bowl with the mushrooms.
Return the reserved pot to medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp sage, dried
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the mushrooms are soft, add broth and soy sauce to the pot. Stir to combine and bring the gravy to a simmer over medium-high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
3 tbsp soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place water and cornstarch in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the slurry.

Once the gravy is simmering, reduce heat to medium-low. Slowly add the cornstarch slurry in a steady stream while stirring constantly. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, 2-3 minutes more.
When the meatballs are done, carefully transfer to a serving dish. Top with half of the gravy and sprinkle with reserved parsley. Serve with remaining gravy on the side.
